content_fields.title: Test for remote file include
content_fields.description: Restrict which remote locations the service may load content from.
content_fields.finding: A caller-supplied URL is fetched and its bytes are embedded in the application's own responses.
content_fields.current_code:
def _image_url_to_base64(image_url: str):
    response = requests.get(image_url, stream=True)
    encoded_image = base64.b64encode(response.content).decode()

    return encoded_image
criteria: Remote content is loaded only from hosts on an allow-list.
Non-HTTPS schemes such as file:, gopher: and ftp: are rejected.
A URL pointing at an internal address is rejected.
